title: Cynergy Bank finances £32m South London retail portfolio
summary:
Real estate finance specialist SHC Capital has arranged an investment term loan from Cynergy Bank for a property investment group, secured against a multi-asset high street retail portfolio in South London valued at £32 million. The group plans to refurbish retail units in the portfolio, which are fully tenanted and generating income.

title: Bridging lender completes £490,000 auction finance in four days
summary:
Bridging lender WSP Capital has completed £490,000 of auction finance at 75% loan-to-value within four days of issuing its formal offer. The transaction was arranged after the borrower's original lender withdrew shortly before the completion deadline.

title: UK property transactions decline 2% year-on-year in August
summary:
UK residential property transactions fell 1% in August compared to July, with HMRC figures showing 95,220 deals completed. The figure represents a 2% decline year-on-year as the market awaits the Chancellor's autumn Budget announcement.

title: London rental demand rises 7% as national market weakens
summary:
Tenant demand in London has increased 7% year-on-year, reversing earlier declines and bucking the national trend where enquiries remain 2% below last year's levels. The capital is now one of only two regions recording annual growth in rental demand, according to Rightmove data.

title: Suffolk estate agent completes eighth acquisition
summary:
A Your Move franchise operator in Suffolk has acquired a lettings agency with 125 managed properties, marking the eighth acquisition completed by the business in 18 months. Oliver Hurren, who runs four Your Move branches across Suffolk, has purchased Your Property Solutions from owners John and Shirley-Ann Carter.

title: Two-thirds of landlords plan rent increases post-reform
summary:
Approximately two-thirds of landlords intend to raise rents following implementation of the Renters' Rights Act, according to new research from the Deposit Protection Service. The proportion planning to sell some or all properties increased from 53% to 56% between October 2025 and May 2026.

title: Cladding remediation backlog increases 12% as approvals slow
summary:
The number of residential buildings awaiting cladding remediation in the UK has risen by 12% since January, with 4,697 blocks now monitored for potential work. Building Safety Regulator approvals are taking 33 weeks to process, while a new levy on development came into force to fund remediation costs.

title: Property tax reform debate intensifies ahead of autumn budget
summary:
The upcoming Autumn Budget presents the Chancellor with competing fiscal pressures as the government seeks to raise revenue whilst maintaining economic growth. Property taxation has emerged as a focal point, with Stamp Duty generating approximately £12 billion annually and debate intensifying over replacing transactional taxes with recurring property taxation.

title: Specialist lender provides £1.9m bridging loan for Watford barn
summary:
Specialist lender Glenhawk has provided a £1.9 million regulated bridging loan secured against a converted barn in Watford, allowing the borrower additional time to market the property. The facility was arranged at 66% loan-to-value and refinanced both a first and second charge on the residential property.
